title: Disjoint low-degree and extended frequencies
statement: Let $n,m$ be nonnegative integers and let $i$ be a coordinate in $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. The family of all subsets of the coordinate set of size at most $m$ is disjoint from the family formed by adjoining $i$ to each $m$-element subset of the other coordinates.
hypotheses_covered: A coordinate $i$ in the coordinate set of size $n$
